subject.title: [Feature]: Generate and update openclaw.json JSON schema on bootstrap/update

question: Should OpenClaw automatically write a local editor schema and add `$schema` during OpenClaw-owned config writes, or should schema attachment remain an explicit user action?
rationale: The remaining change adds a new default side effect to config writes and affects user-visible local files, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept local schema on config writes
options.body: Proceed with a guarded implementation like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89992 that preserves user-owned schema values and include-backed roots while adding tests and docs.

options.title: Keep schema generation manual
options.body: Leave `openclaw config schema` as the supported path and close the linked implementation PRs as not planned for automatic config mutation.

options.title: Narrow to setup or doctor
options.body: Offer the schema sidecar through an explicit setup or doctor fix path instead of changing ordinary config write behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept local schema on config writes
recommendation.body: Proceed with a guarded implementation like https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89992 that preserves user-owned schema values and include-backed roots while adding tests and docs.
